theme_stances.key_argument: Increased buybacks will anchor long-end volatility and act as a quasi-Twist to stabilize the curve.
theme_stances.evidence: The Treasury is showing a strong preference to subdue term premium.

theme_stances.key_argument: Treasury support for the long end will likely come at the expense of a weaker USD.
theme_stances.evidence: Supporting bonds may come at the expense of letting the USD become the adjustment valve.

theme_stances.key_argument: Policymakers can influence the path of yields temporarily but cannot change the structural destination driven by fiscal and capital demand factors.
theme_stances.evidence: Twists can change the path, but they rarely change the destination.

theme_stances.key_argument: Treasury's willingness to use buybacks to manage duration is bullish for equities and gold.
theme_stances.evidence: The response to pressure in the long end can include changing the way Treasury manages duration.

theme_stances.key_argument: Increased buybacks will anchor long-end volatility and support a bull flattener.
theme_stances.evidence: The bull flattener makes sense in this context.

theme_stances.key_argument: Treasury prioritizing yield control over FX stability will likely lead to a weaker USD.
theme_stances.evidence: Supporting bonds may come at the expense of letting the USD become the adjustment valve.

theme_stances.key_argument: US Treasury liquidity support buyback operations
theme_stances.evidence: US Treasury liquidity support buyback operations

tension_points.bull_case: Buybacks act as a 'quasi-Twist' to stabilize the long end and support risk assets.
tension_points.bear_case: Underlying supply remains high and deficits will continue to weigh on duration.
tension_points.what_invalidates: If the market stops believing Treasury will use liability-management tools to stabilize the long end.

tension_points.bull_case: Buybacks act as a stabilizer for the long end and anchor volatility.
tension_points.bear_case: Underlying supply from deficits and AI spending remains, preventing a deep rally in yields.
